title.value: Beyond Prediction Accuracy: From Transferable Crop Water-Stress Forecasts to Field-Level Irrigation Decisions

instrument_type.source_ref: call_binding/selected_call.json (call-scoped fact); draft cover block ¶7 'MSCA Host', §1.1.3 ¶48 'The MSCA fellowship'

cross_country_transferability_environmen.value: Agricultural Academy / Maritsa Vegetable Crops Research Institute (MVCRI), Bulgaria

project_in_one_sentence.value: FIELDWISE will use five years of MATE hyperspectral, soil and meteorological observations to identify physiologically meaningful early water-stress signatures in high-value processing tomato, determine which signatures can be scaled to Sentinel-2, develop uncertainty-aware prospective forecasts, rigorously test their temporal transferability at MATE, geographic transferability at MVCRI in Bulgaria and operational transferability under AgroVIR farmer-field conditions, and translate the validated intelligence into the DrR - Digital Agronomist web MVP for field-level irrigation decisions.

core_message.value: FIELDWISE moves agricultural AI beyond retrospective accuracy by asking whether a water-stress signal discovered under scientific conditions can survive the entire journey from plant physiology to satellite observation, from Hungary to Bulgaria, and from experimental fields to farming reality-while arriving early enough to improve the irrigation decision.

duration_note: Project duration is deliberately not duplicated here. The 30-month duration (24-month European Fellowship plus 6-month non-academic placement) is an operator decision, not a draft fact, and its single authoritative home is call_binding/selected_call.json per the ticket 3 deviation record.
